race.comment: LIGULARIA (3) resumes from nearly a year in the paddock, and has had a couple of preps to get ready for her return here. She has a good gate, and is expected to be very competitive. Each way. BALLET D'LIGHT (5) won her latest trial, and from a good draw, she should be kept safe in all combos, especially with JMac in the irons. MEDOCAINE (12) has improved in each of her 2 public trials to date, and she can take another step forward on race day. Follow any market confidence. BORN TO FLY (6) has been to the fore in all of her 5 public trials, including wins in her last couple during September. She carries some gear, so if not too green, she will be right in the thick of things. TESTAMAPATIENCE (14) has continued to improve in every trial, and she should be kept safe in all top 4 combos.
